title: ptarmica macrophylla
intro: Ptarmica macrophylla, commonly known as large-leaved snail puccoon or large-leaved ironwort, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. The plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, making it beneficial for soothing wounds, reducing fever, and alleviating digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Ptarmica macrophylla are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, such as sesquiterpenes and diterpenes. The health benefits of Ptarmica macrophylla are diverse, ranging from wound healing and antimicrobial actions to anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
